records.finding: The public Wilson law uses plaquette energy and product Haar measure on four-dimensional periodic lattices.
records.obligation: Define the 3D finite lattice law with its own link and plaquette geometry; verify normalization and a one-plaquette SU(2) test.

records.finding: The upstream spacetime and lattice axis type is explicitly four-dimensional.
records.obligation: Provide a new Fin 3 Euclidean lattice geometry and show all lifted link/plaquette identities there.

records.finding: The public regularity requirement fixes beta/log(1/a) to a positive limiting slope, appropriate to the 4D claim.
records.obligation: Replace rather than import this condition: use dimensionful 3D coupling, beta=4/(a*g3^2) for the stated SU(2) convention, and prove certified RG correction bounds.

records.finding: A bridge connects finite Wilson moments to ordered limit readouts through an already-supplied extraction hypothesis.
records.obligation: Separate pure algebraic readout identities from convergence hypotheses and reprove the latter in 3D.

records.finding: The advertised construction is assembled from nonperturbative existence and multiple bridge hypotheses, all scoped to its source definitions.
records.obligation: Trace the actual analytic dependencies and determine whether any 3D estimate follows from dimension-independent hypotheses; do not treat the final 4D theorem as an RG rung.

records.finding: The continuum endpoint packages source extraction, OPE, contacts and reconstruction via a previously constructed funded run.
records.obligation: Audit source hypotheses of the funded run and each intermediate estimate; identify explicit 3D analogues before importing any bound.

records.finding: The source selects a run using a campaign theorem and named resource/precision suppliers.
records.obligation: Trace the selection theorem through its quantitative inequalities; check scale, volume, gauge and cutoff dependence, and derive an independent 3D estimate.

records.finding: The Funded structure packages log budget, halo and polymer conditions; the label alone does not imply a 3D KP certificate.
records.obligation: Extract exact norms, polymer classes, large-field assumptions and their numerical margins; map these to typed 3D activities.

records.finding: A block/scale supplier combines floor conditions, delays and budget-like receipt fields in the upstream formal development.
records.obligation: Show each condition corresponds to a physical 3D Wilson measure estimate, not only to an abstract resource predicate.

records.finding: A public bridge constructs Wightman/reconstruction properties from an upstream phase and hierarchy witness.
records.obligation: Verify reflection-positive 3D Schwinger functions of the original lattice measure and the continuous observable sector independently.

records.finding: The implementation audits theorem declarations, permitted axioms and kernel replay against a separate reference environment.
records.obligation: Reuse the proof-audit methodology only; pin dependencies and keep independently checked theorem statements distinct from physical interpretations.

records.finding: The independent review ties finite Wilson laws, moments, volume extraction and coupling calibration to one common source witness.
records.obligation: Recreate this common-witness acceptance contract on the 3D law rather than importing its 4D result.

records.anchor: scalar family, not a separately specified all-field OS interface
records.finding: The working-group OS bridge concerns a selected centered scalar family, not a separately specified all-field OS interface.
records.obligation: Prove positivity and compatibility for the desired 3D gauge-invariant observable algebra, not only a distinguished scalar.

records.finding: The acceptance target includes a positive lattice probe but explicitly does not assert a physical intrinsic mass gap.
records.obligation: Establish nonzero spectral lower bound in physical units after the thermodynamic and continuum limits; a positive probe is insufficient.

records.finding: The review project specifies pinned Lean builds, Comparator checks and limits of its recorded environment.
records.obligation: Adopt reproducibility logs, toolchain pins and an explicit list of unverified review modes; do not mistake reported builds for local reproduction.

records.finding: The gas_diff theorem bounds a difference of forced-activity gases assuming the forced-address census agrees; its module denies volume-independent bounds.
records.obligation: Reprove the finite algebraic part on the 3D support inventory, then separately certify configuration- and volume-uniform genuine SU(2) activity norms.

records.finding: Admissible forced subsets require disjoint supports and exactly cover cutoff flags with their inventories; this predicate is not an automatic consequence of link symmetry.
records.obligation: Establish a matching 3D support/inventory model and a separate budget for eligibility changes under gauge and cutoff transformations.

records.finding: The clusters source warns its absolute graph-series estimates do not independently supply physical gas positivity or the exponential/logarithm identity.
records.obligation: Prove the identification between K-star collision graph activities and Wilson-derived polymers before claiming a 3D cluster or RG result.

records.finding: The source run selector packages a preselected sheet, quote and numeric payments, then constructs a single Run with Funded and period/treasury receipts.
records.obligation: Trace every preselection receipt into a concrete finite-dimensional Wilson integral and a scale-uniform 3D norm estimate; the formal resource predicate alone cannot close an RG gate.

global_nonclaims: No checked 3D analytic RG estimate is imported.
The cited 4D theorem is not a 3D theorem.
A positive lattice probe is not a physical mass gap.
The working-group assessment is a stated opinion; this crosswalk does not rerun Lean or Comparator.
No new program.yaml gate is closed by this audit.
